name: Devin Bots
desc: Persistent agents that own an outcome and lead teams of Devins.
desc_zh: 守住一个目标、并能带领一组 Devin 的常驻智能体。
solves: Task-by-task delegation leaves the engineer doing the planning; a bot keeps a goal, decides the next step, and brings back only the decisions.
solves_zh: 逐个派任务时规划和跟进仍压在工程师身上；机器人守住目标、自己决定下一步，只把需要人拍板的决定带回来。
best_for: A repo needs continuous attention, such as keeping two platforms at parity, and no one owns it.
best_for_zh: 某个仓库需要长期投入，比如保持两个平台功能一致，而又没人负责。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — devin.ai/blog directory）。 The blog index renders the same post as 2026-11-18 in Asia/Shanghai; the post page and the docs changelog both say November 17. 首次公开日期来源：https://devin.ai/blog/introducing-devin-bots
